draft.subject: safeguards for client data
draft.body:
Hi Sharon,

A different angle. The SRA warning notice of 17 August 2026 allows client data into AI tools only with contractual, technical and organisational safeguards.

Are those safeguards something Langford Pierce has in place?

claims.text: The SRA warning notice of 17 August 2026 allows client data into AI tools only with contractual, technical and organisational safeguards

evidence.text: Legal Innovation Counsel. Evaluate and roll out AI tools across our litigation practice.

facts.wording: Built an AI legal assistant platform for research and document help for a legal-tech venture (Legal AI).
ABA Formal Opinion 512 says a lawyer needs the client's informed consent before putting client information into a self-learning generative AI tool.
A 17+ person team of engineers, AI specialists and analysts, based in San Jose.

earlier_steps.subject: your legal innovation counsel role
earlier_steps.body:
Hi Sharon,

Saw Langford Pierce is hiring legal innovation counsel to roll out AI tools across the litigation practice. Doing that without client data leaving the firm is usually the hard part.

Worth a look?
